## Teaching Philosophy

I aim to connect transportation engineering theory to problems students can see in their
own cities — congestion, crashes, and unequal access to mobility. My courses combine
foundational modeling with hands-on work using real traffic and transit datasets, so
students leave able to apply these methods in practice, not just on exams.
